title: Jacob's ladders and new $ζ$-functionals and corresponding $ζ$-equivalents of the Fermat-Wiles theory based on sums of elementary $ζ$-pulses
summary: In this paper we obtain some sum-variants of our first $ζ$-equivalent of the Fermat-Wiles theorem. For example, on the Riemann hypothesis, we give a new type of $ζ$-equivalent based on a sum of isolated rectangle-shaped signals (pulses).
